title: Purple Velvet Crop & Burnout Skirt
prompt: This is a duplicate of section 122. An original young woman with long, wavy honey-blonde hair walks a dirt path through tall grass. She wears a purple velvet cropped long-sleeve top with flared cuffs, a black velvet burnout maxi skirt with a side slit, and a chain belt with a cross charm. Tall black boots complete the look. Soft, late-afternoon light and blurred trees. Palette of violet, black, and sage green. Nostalgic and moody, in the style of a boho gothic editorial.
workingNotes:
- Keep only one of sections 122 or 142 if you do not need both.
- The velvet crop and chain belt are the key details.
tryThis: Try this: Emphasize the velvet crop and chain belt.
